title: Fish Tacos
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

items.raw: Water warm 1 & ½ Cup or as required
Yellow fish boneless cubes ½ kg
Lal mirch powder (Red chilli powder) 1 tsp or to taste
Kali mirch powder (Black pepper powder) 1 tsp

steps.instruction: In a bowl,add cornmeal,all-purpose flour,salt & mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein makai ka atta,maida aur namak dal ker ache tarhan mix karein.
Cooking oil shamil karein aur mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Gradually add warm water & knead until medium soft dough is formed,cover & let it rest for 10-15 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Thora thora ker ka neem garam pani shamil karein aur ghond ker medium soft dough tayyar ker lein aur dhak ker 10-15 minutes kliya rakh dein.

steps.instruction: Dust dry flour & knead dough again,grease hands with oil & knead dough again.
steps.romanUrdu: Atta chirak dein aur dough ko dubara ghond lein,haath ko oil sa grease karein aur dough ko dubara ghomd lein.

steps.instruction: Take a small dough & make a ball,dust dry flour & roll out with the help of rolling pin and prick with fork (makes 15).
steps.romanUrdu: Chota dough la ker ball lein aur atta chirak ker rolling pin ki madad sa bail lein phir fork sa prick ker lein (makes 15).

steps.instruction: Now place the taco tortillas on oven grill and bake in preheated oven at 180 C for 10 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Ab taco tortilla ko oven rack per rakh dein aur preheated oven mein 180 C per 10 minutes kliya bake ker lein.
Baking ka bad thanda ker lein.

steps.instruction: On griddle,add cooking oil and spread it.
steps.romanUrdu: Tawa per cooking oil dal ker pheela lein.

steps.instruction: Place rolled dough and cook from both sides until light brown.
steps.romanUrdu: Rolled dough rakh dein aur dono sides sa light brown hunay tak paka lein.

steps.instruction: Fold taco in half & hold and cook for 30 seconds.
steps.romanUrdu: Taco ko half fold ker ka hold ker lein aur 30 seconds kliya paka lein.

steps.instruction: In a bowl,add fish boneless cubes,cumin powder,red chilli powder,salt,black pepper powder and lemon juice,mix well and marinate for 15 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein fish boneless cubes,zeera powder,lal mirch powder,namak,kali mirch powder aur lemon juice dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur 15 minutes kliya marinate ker lein.

steps.instruction: In a frying pan,add cooking oil and cook marinated fish for 3-4 minutes or until dries up & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: Frying pan mein cooking oil dal dein aur marinated fish ko 3-4 minutes ya pani sukh janay tak paka lein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In a bowl,add cream,lemon juice & whisk well.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein cream aur lemon juice dal ker ache tarhan whisk karein.

steps.instruction: Add milk,whisk well and rest it for 15 minutes.Sour cream is ready!
steps.romanUrdu: Doodh dal ker ache tarhan whisk ker lein aur 15 minutes kliya chor dein.Sour cream tayyar hai!

steps.instruction: To assemble tacos,add iceberg lettuce,cooked fish chunks,red bell pepper,capsicum,onion,tomatoes,
steps.romanUrdu: Taco shell mein iceberg lettuce,cooked fish chunks,red bell pepper,shimla mirch,pyaz,tamatar, jalapenos,tayyar sour cream aur paprika powder dal ker serve karein!

steps.instruction: jalapenos,prepared sour cream,sprinkle paprika powder & serve!

ogDescription: These Fish tacos are just WOW do give this recipe a try. #HappyCookingToYou #FoodFusion
